summary.name: Trace
summary.one_liner: Trace is a fast, native macOS app launcher and Spotlight alternative that also offers window snapping, shortcut tools, and push-to-talk dictation.
use_cases: Launch apps quickly from the keyboard
Snap windows to halves or thirds
Run menu bar commands without using the mouse
Dictate text privately into any app
Keep a Mac awake from the keyboard
Back up launcher setup to a self-hosted server
summary.what_it_does: Trace is a macOS launcher opened with a hotkey (default ⌥ space, customizable) that fuzzy-searches applications with ranking. It snaps windows to halves, thirds, or custom positions and lets you search and run menu items from the previous app's menu bar. Push-to-talk dictation transcribes speech on-device into the current text field while a hotkey is held. Other built-in tools include a calculator, calendar access, an emoji picker with 1550+ emojis, live CPU and memory usage for running apps, Keep Awake, and a camera preview.
notable: Built with 100% native Swift, requires macOS 26+ and Apple Silicon
Push-to-talk dictation with private on-device transcription
Settings backup and restore through a self-hosted sync server
Listed as open-source and freeware in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac
